titre: Budget d investissement annoncé par le premier fondeur mondial
sous_titre: Milliards de dollars, fourchette annoncée pour chaque année, 2023 à 2026

2023.texte: The management further expects the 2023 capital budget to be between US$32 billion and US$36 billion.

2024.texte: The management further expects the 2024 capital budget to be between US$28 billion and US$32 billion.

2025.texte: The management further expects the 2025 capital budget to be between US$38 billion and US$42 billion.

2026.texte: The management further expects the 2026 capital budget to be between US$52 billion and US$56 billion.
